free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: Free, explicitly unmetered. 'Unlimited Bandwidth / Never worry about traffic spikes or overage fees'; HLS delivery from their CDN.

tooling: XFileSharing-style api.html + PolyUploader (github.com/spel987/PolyUploader) lists StreamRuby; XFS '?op=api' key pattern applies
chaining: The quota scales with views rather than accounts, i.e. 250 GB + 250 GB per 1.5k monthly views. A view-inflation loop (or simply many free accounts) turns this into an unbounded pool; each account independently starts at 250 GB.
limits_note: 20,000 MB (20 GB) per file per the official plan table; video-only (HLS transcode); 60-day deletion when unviewed for free tier
reliability_note: video-only: everything is transcoded to HLS, so it is not byte-exact storage; free-tier storage allowance is recomputed monthly from views, so it can shrink (existing videos are not deleted)
confidence_note: Unverified: carried from historical research records without live verification. A first-party page read confirms documentation.
